title: Protein Array
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs a protein array on ONCYTE SuperNOVA slides mounted on an Inheco Teleshake 1536 using a P300 multi-channel pipette. For reagent setup in the 12-channel reservoir, see 'Additional Notes' below. Note that the user is prompted three times to engage and disengage the shaker (mounted on the deck). The Teleshake with slides will occupy slots 1, 2, 4, and 5, and will be calibrated from slot 4. --- * [Grace ONCYTE SuperNOVA 16-well slides #705116](https://gracebio.com/product/oncyte-supernova-705116/) * Custom 4-slide adapter for Inheco Teleshake 1536 (each slide with 8x2 square wells) * [Bio-Rad Hard Shell 96-Well PCR plate 200ul #hsp9601 (if automatically adding samples)](http://www.bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsp9601-hard-shell-96-well-pcr-plates-low-profile-thin-wall-skirted-white-clear?ID=hsp9601) * [Agilent 1-Well Reservoir 290mL #201252-100](https://www.agilent.com/store/en_US/Prod-201252-100/201252-100) * [USA Scientific 12-Well Reservoir 22mL #1061-8150](https://www.usascientific.com/12-channel-automation-reservoir.aspx) * [Opentrons P300 multi-channel electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette?variant=5984202489885) * [Opentrons 300ul pipette tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-300ul-tips?variant=15954632802398) * [Inheco Teleshake 1536](https://www.inheco.com/fileadmin/web_data/Downloads/Data-Sheets/Shaker.pdf) --- 12-channel reservoir * Super G plus blocking buffer: channel 1 * Secondary antibody: channel 2 * PBST: channels 3-6 * Super G: channel 7

steps.title: Gather hardware and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect all required items: ONCYTE SuperNOVA 16‑well slides (#705116), custom 4‑slide adapter for Inheco Teleshake 1536, Bio‑Rad Hard Shell 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL) if using automatic sample addition, Agilent 1‑well 290 mL reservoir (#201252‑100), USA Scientific 12‑well 22 mL reservoir (#1061‑8150), Opentrons P300 multi‑channel electronic pipette, Opentrons 300 µL pipette tips, and the Inheco Teleshake 1536 shaker.

steps.title: Load slides onto Teleshake
steps.instruction: Mount the ONCYTE SuperNOVA slides on the Inheco Teleshake 1536 using the custom adapter; place the loaded Teleshake on deck slots 1, 2, 4, and 5, and set the calibration reference to slot 4.

steps.title: Fill 12‑channel reservoir
steps.instruction: Load reagents into the 12‑channel reservoir as follows: channel 1 – Super G plus blocking buffer; channel 2 – secondary antibody; channels 3‑6 – PBST; channel 7 – Super G.

steps.title: Configure P300 pipette settings
steps.instruction: In the OT App, set the mount for the P300 multi‑channel pipette, specify the number of slides to process (1‑4), and choose the sample‑addition mode (manual or automatic).

steps.title: Download and upload protocol package
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package provided for the protein array, then upload both the custom labware definitions and the protocol file into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the deck items according to the supplied deck map: tip rack, reservoirs, PCR plate (if used), and the calibrated Teleshake with slides.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the tip rack, all labware, and the P300 pipette; ensure the slides mounted on the Teleshake are calibrated to the exact aspiration location.

steps.title: Execute protocol run
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App; the system will pause three times for you to engage and disengage the Teleshake shaker as prompted.
